WITH book AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.strategy, o.market_ticker
  FROM live_orders o JOIN fills f ON f.kalshi_order_id = o.kalshi_order_id
  WHERE o.action='buy' AND o.strategy IS NOT NULL AND o.created_at >= '2026-07-01'
), newest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, p.captured_at, p.quantity, p.realized_pnl,
         (p.raw_json::text LIKE '%settled_time%') AS is_settle
  FROM positions p WHERE p.market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM book)
  ORDER BY p.market_ticker, p.captured_at DESC, p.id DESC
), flat AS (
  SELECT n.*, (SELECT min(p2.captured_at) FROM positions p2
               WHERE p2.market_ticker = n.market_ticker AND p2.quantity = 0
                 AND p2.realized_pnl = n.realized_pnl) AS first_flat
  FROM newest n
  WHERE n.quantity = 0 AND n.realized_pnl IS NOT NULL AND n.captured_at >= '2026-10-01'
)
SELECT b.strategy, count(*) AS n_counted_oct,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.first_flat < '2026-10-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_flat_before_oct,
  round(sum(f.realized_pnl)::numeric, 2) AS raw_pnl_counted_oct,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN f.first_flat < '2026-10-01' THEN f.realized_pnl ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS raw_pnl_flat_before_oct,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.is_settle THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS n_from_positions_feed,
  min(f.first_flat) AS earliest_first_flat
FROM flat f JOIN book b USING (market_ticker)
GROUP BY b.strategy ORDER BY b.strategy
